description: This file defines the AppState class that manages global application state in a Flutter app, including authentication tokens, site data, workflows, verifications, and related actions. It uses ChangeNotifier for state management and interacts with external APIs and shared preferences.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that maintains and updates the application's global state, including authentication, site data, workflows, and verifications.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads the authentication token from shared preferences.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication and resets site, verification, and workflow data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login via API, loads token, and fetches sites.

methods.name: checkHealth
methods.description: Checks the health/status of the backend API.

methods.name: fetchSites
methods.description: Fetches a list of sites from the backend API.

methods.name: selectSiteById
methods.description: Selects a site by ID and fetches related verifications and workflow steps.

methods.name: fetchVerifications
methods.description: Fetches verifications for a specific site.

methods.name: runVerification
methods.description: Triggers a verification process for a site.

methods.name: fetchWorkflowSteps
methods.description: Fetches workflow steps for a specific site.

methods.name: completeStep
methods.description: Marks a workflow step as completed.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Internal method to set loading state.

methods.name: _setError
methods.description: Internal method to set error message.
